newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's CSRC approves Zhenhua 100 mln B share IPO.
newsitem.headline: China's CSRC approves Zhenhua 100 mln B share IPO.

text.p: Shanghai Zhenhua Port Machinery Co Ltd has been given the go-ahead to launch an initial public offering of 100 million B shares in mid-July, a company spokesman said on Thursday.

The IPO would carry a price/earnings ratio of nine to 11 times based on forecast 1997 net profits of 117 million yuan under international accounting standards, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The IPO had been approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) for listing on the Shanghai bourse, he said.
China Securities Co (CSC) had been appointed the domestic lead underwriter and ABN-Amro Hoare Govett the global coordinator, he said.
Zhenhua planned to use the B share proceeds to expand its core business making port cargo handling equipment, he said.
Zhenhua, based in eastern China's metropolis of Shanghai, exported 80 percent of its products to North America and Southeast Asia and sold the other 20 percent domestically, a CSC official said.
Zhenhua booked net profits of 86 million yuan for 1996 under international accounting standards, she said, adding Zhenhua had 235 million outstanding shares held by its founders.
